title: Peter confesses Jesus as the Messiah and the first prediction of suffering
description: At Caesarea Philippi, Peter confesses that Jesus is the Messiah. Then Jesus openly predicts his suffering, death, and resurrection for the first time. When Peter rebukes him, Jesus responds sharply: "Get behind me, Satan!" He then teaches the disciples and the crowd that whoever wants to follow him must deny themselves and take up their cross.
